AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Nutrition.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Nutrition.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Nutrition.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Breeding? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Breeding.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Breeding.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Breeding.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Erosion Control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Erosion Control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Erosion Control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Erosion Control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Erosion Control.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Urban and peri-urban Agriculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Powered Agricultural Implements? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Powered Agricultural Implements.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Powered Agricultural Implements.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Powered Agricultural Implements.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Powered Agricultural Implements.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Breeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Disease Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.

2. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

3. A — newton (N)

4. C — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.

6. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Erosion Control.

8. D — Producers

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.

10. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.

11. D — 100 °C

12. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Powered Agricultural Implements.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Livestock Nutrition; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Animal Breeding; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Animal Health: Disease Control; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
